log_rgbd_to_rerun: log posed RGBD image, depthmap, camera pose, and intrinsics data to a Rerun visualization session
add_rerun_cli_args: add common Rerun viewer CLI arguments like headless, connect, serve, url, and save to an ArgumentParser
init_rerun_namespace: initialize a Namespace object with default Rerun script arguments for headless, connect, serve, url, save, and stdout
predictions_to_glb_mesh: convert model predictions with world points, images, and masks into a trimesh 3D scene as a mesh or point cloud
str2bool_conversion: convert a string value to a boolean using distutils strtobool for CLI argument parsing
